newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest -July 31.

text.p: REUTERS FRENCH ADVERTISING & MEDIA DIGEST
News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising,
Marketing, Media & the
Internet and Brand-name Products.
ADVERTISING, MEDIA & THE INTERNET:
PARIS - Canal Plus, the French pay TV group, welcomes a
broadcasting law approved by the Italian parliament on Tuesday,
saying it will provide a stable environment for pay-TV channel
Telepiu and help the development of digital television platform.
(Reuter)
PARIS - A technical error by Canal France International that
resulted in the broadcast of a pornographic film to the Arab
world instead of a scheduled children's programme, could cost
the French channel 50 million francs ($8.1 million), according
to an initial estimate. Arabsat cancelling its contract with CFI
as a result of the broadcasting error. (Le Figaro)
PARIS - Le Monde, the French newspaper, has offered to buy
L'Express, the weekly news magazine, from Havas, says Le Monde
Managing Director Jean-Marie Colombani. (La Tribune)
PARIS - The major French television channels have not gone to
the trouble this year to broadcast special summer series,
relying instead on repeat showings. TF1 says the public is happy
to get familiar programmes, France 2 says it is showing the same
proportion of repeats as it does during the rest of the year,
while M6 says its viewers are all on holiday. (Le Parisien)
BRAND-NAME PRODUCTS & MARKETS:
PARIS - Perrier-Vittel, the French mineral water unit of Swiss
food and drink group Nestle, says its first foray into the soft
drinks market will target the important youth segment.(Reuter)
PARIS - French carmaker PSA Peugeot Citroen reports first-half
turnover rose 6.3 percent to 94.64 billion francs, bolstered by
brisk sales of its new light commercial vehicles and a surge in
exports of cars and car parts. (Reuter)
